items.label: Top-up tiers
items.note: Led 4 teams, live in six weeks

notes: Second, top-up cards. We had seven top-up tiers. Staff couldn't explain them and members couldn't do the maths, so more people held cards but they didn't come back more often. I cut seven tiers to three and added a balance reminder. That touched store scripts, finance, the till system and marketing material, so I asked each of the four teams for one person, we met weekly, and it went live in six weeks. Among our 480,000 card members, 90-day repeat visits rose from 31% to 38%, and new top-ups reached RMB 186 million in 2024, up 22% on the year before.
